title: Mood and Emotion in Major Depression
summary: Nothing is more familiar to people than their moods and emotions. Oddly, however, it is not clear how these two kinds of affective processes are related. Intuitively, it makes sense that emotional reactions are stronger when they are congruent with a preexisting mood, an idea reinforced by contemporary emotion theory. Yet empirically, it is uncertain whether moods actually facilitate emotional reactivity to mood-congruent stimuli. One approach to the question of how moods affect emotions is to study mood-disturbed individuals. This review describes recent experimental studies of emotional reactivity conducted with individuals suffering from major depression. Counter to intuitions, major depression is associated with reduced emotional reactivity to sad contexts. A novel account of emotions in depression is advanced to assimilate these findings. Implications for the study of depression and normal mood variation are considered.

标题：重度抑郁症中的情绪与情感  
摘要：人们对自身的情绪和情感最为熟悉。然而奇怪的是，这两种情感过程之间的关系尚不明确。直觉上，当情绪反应与既有的心境一致时会更强烈，这一观点在现代情绪理论中被强化。但实证研究尚不确定心境是否实际促进了对心境一致刺激的情绪反应性。研究心境如何影响情绪的一个途径是考察心境紊乱的个体。本综述描述了近期针对重度抑郁症患者进行的情绪反应性实验研究。与直觉相反，重度抑郁症与对悲伤情境的情绪反应性降低相关。本文提出了一种关于抑郁症中情绪的新解释以整合这些发现，并探讨了其对抑郁研究和正常心境变异的启示。  
关键词：重度抑郁症；情绪反应性；心境一致性；情感过程；情绪理论

title: Positive and Negative Emotion Regulation in Adolescence: Links to Anxiety and Depression
summary: Emotion regulation skills develop substantially across adolescence, a period characterized by emotional challenges and developing regulatory neural circuitry. Adolescence is also a risk period for the new onset of anxiety and depressive disorders, psychopathologies which have long been associated with disruptions in regulation of positive and negative emotions. This paper reviews the current understanding of the role of disrupted emotion regulation in adolescent anxiety and depression, describing findings from self-report, behavioral, peripheral psychophysiological, and neural measures. Self-report studies robustly identified associations between emotion dysregulation and adolescent anxiety and depression. Findings from behavioral and psychophysiological studies are mixed, with some suggestion of specific impairments in reappraisal in anxiety. Results from neuroimaging studies broadly implicate altered functioning of amygdala-prefrontal cortical circuitries, although again, findings are mixed regarding specific patterns of altered neural functioning. Future work may benefit from focusing on designs that contrast effects of specific regulatory strategies, and isolate changes in emotional regulation from emotional reactivity. Approaches to improve treatments based on empirical evidence of disrupted emotion regulation in adolescents are also discussed. Future intervention studies might consider training and measurement of specific strategies in adolescents to better understand the role of emotion regulation as a treatment mechanism.

标题：青少年积极与消极情绪调节：与焦虑和抑郁的关联
摘要：情绪调节能力在青少年时期显著发展，这一阶段以情绪挑战和发育中的调节神经环路为特征。青春期也是焦虑症和抑郁症新发的高风险期，这些精神病理状态长期被认为与积极和消极情绪的调节紊乱有关。本文综述了当前关于情绪调节紊乱在青少年焦虑和抑郁中作用的理解，描述了来自自我报告、行为、外周心理生理和神经测量的发现。自我报告研究明确揭示了情绪失调与青少年焦虑和抑郁之间的关联。行为和心理生理学研究的结果不一，部分提示焦虑症患者在重新评估方面存在特定缺陷。神经影像学研究结果普遍涉及杏仁核-前额叶皮层环路功能的改变，尽管关于神经功能改变的具体模式仍存在混合结果。未来研究可能受益于聚焦对比特定调节策略效果的实验设计，并将情绪调节的变化与情绪反应性区分开来。本文还讨论了基于青少年情绪调节紊乱经验证据来改进治疗方法的方向。未来的干预研究可考虑在青少年中训练和测量特定策略，以更好地理解情绪调节作为治疗机制的作用。
关键词：情绪调节；青少年；焦虑；抑郁；神经机制

title: Ketamine and facial emotion recognition in treatment-resistant depression: a computational account
summary: Background: Facial emotion recognition deficits are well defined in depression but understudied in treatment-resistant depression (TRD). Over the past decades, subanesthetic doses of ketamine have emerged as an effective treatment for TRD, but its effect on affective processing is still little known. Approaches from computational psychiatry, such as sequential evidence sampling models of decision making, can provide useful insight into the underlying cognitive processes of facial emotion recognition in TRD patients before and after ketamine antidepressant treatment.Aim: Provide a computational account of facial emotion recognition in TRD and the effects of ketamine treatment using hierarchical drift diffusion modeling (HDDM).Method: In this observational case-control study, 24 TRD patients and 35 healthy controls completed a FER task. TRD patients were assessed before, 2-4 hours after the initial racemic ketamine infusion, and at one week of treatment. Healthy controls were assessed at similar intervals, without intervention, to assess baseline differences and potential learning effects related to task repetition. Accuracy and reaction times were analyzed and fit with an HDDM to formalize correct facial emotion recognition as a noisy evidence-accumulation process. Parameters of the best-fitting model were compared across groups and timepoints.Results: Before treatment, TRD patients were slower but as accurate as controls. Following ketamine, the patients were significantly faster than at baseline and compared with repeated testing in healthy controls. These effects were underpinned by longer nondecision times and wider decision boundaries in patients at baseline, both of which decreased after starting ketamine. There was no behavioral or computational evidence of a negative bias in patients.Conclusions: Results suggest that processes related to psychomotor slowing and response caution, rather than affective processing, underlie deficits observed during facial emotion recognition in TRD and can be restored after starting a ketamine treatment.

标题：氯胺酮与难治性抑郁症中的面部情绪识别：一种计算模型研究
摘要：背景：面部情绪识别缺陷在抑郁症中已被明确记录，但在难治性抑郁症（TRD）中研究不足。过去数十年，亚麻醉剂量的氯胺酮已作为TRD的有效治疗方法出现，但其对情感加工的影响仍知之甚少。计算精神病学的方法，如决策的序贯证据采样模型，可以为TRD患者在氯胺酮抗抑郁治疗前后面部情绪识别的潜在认知过程提供有益见解。目的：通过层次漂移扩散模型（HDDM）提供TRD中面部情绪识别及氯胺酮治疗效应的计算模型解释。方法：本观察性病例对照研究中，24名TRD患者和35名健康对照完成了一项面部情绪识别任务。TRD患者在初始消旋氯胺酮输注前、输注后2-4小时及治疗一周时进行评估。健康对照组在相似时间间隔内接受评估，但无干预，以评估基线差异及任务重复相关的潜在学习效应。分析准确率与反应时，并与HDDM拟合，将正确的面部情绪识别形式化为一个含噪声的证据累积过程。比较最佳拟合模型的参数在组间及时间点上的差异。结果：治疗前，TRD患者反应较慢但准确率与对照组相当。氯胺酮治疗后，患者反应显著快于基线，并且与健康对照组的重复测试相比也更快。这些效应源于患者基线时较长的非决策时间和更宽的反应边界，两者在氯胺酮治疗后均有所降低。未发现患者存在负性偏倚的行为或计算证据。结论：结果表明，与精神运动迟缓和反应谨慎性相关的加工过程（而非情感加工）是TRD患者在面部情绪识别中观察到的缺陷的基础，且该缺陷可在氯胺酮治疗后恢复。
关键词：难治性抑郁症；面部情绪识别；氯胺酮；计算精神病学；层次漂移扩散模型
